generator_view.scenario: A buyer has a total budget of $80 and wants one over-ear headphone for home desk use through 2036. Open-back leakage is acceptable, and their source can drive 250-ohm headphones.
generator_view.target: Audit the frozen product claims, rechargeable-battery limits, and long-use or repair anecdotes, then choose the best-supported route for the stated priorities without promising that any model will certainly survive to 2036.

query: I have a total budget 80 dollars and need one headphone for home desk over ear use through 2036. Open back leakage acceptable, and my source can drive 250 ohms. Compare the DT990 Pro wired, Srhythm NC35 wireless, and AKG K72 wired routes. Put serviceability before wireless convenience and avoid irreplaceable battery dependency. Audit each frozen listing's price, wired or wireless operation, stated replacement claims, battery and passive fallback, and practical desk-use limitations. Explain what rechargeable-battery capacity loss does and does not establish. Also separate other model owner reports from same model lifetime proof when using long-use, component-replacement, and cable anecdotes. Recommend one route, explain the tradeoffs, retain the open-back, impedance, cable, seller-evidence, and uncertain-2036-lifetime caveats, and cite each factual claim to its sandbox source.
